events.text: Correction to shell-stripped command names in the resolution: look must return structured no-live-mesh state, and new must create the first real model through the always-mounted shell-level Seat receiver.

resolution: Established the correct Agent Seat bootstrap contract: the control plane cannot be mounted by ModelView, because that requires the user to create a disposable model solely to expose the API and the agent then correctly replaces it with its own  operation. The Seat receiver must be owned by the always-mounted editor shell from process startup;  must answer immediately with structured no-live-mesh state,  must create the first real model through the shell, and mesh-only verbs must reject cleanly until one exists. No manual prerequisite or throwaway model is acceptable.
